citations.text: White, J. G., Southgate, E., Thomson, J. N., Brenner, S. (1986). The Structure of the Nervous System of the Nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. B 314, 1-340.

description: Directed weighted multigraph of chemical synapses in the adult hermaphrodite C. elegans. Edge weight = synapse count between neuron pair. Multiple edges between same pair when different synapse types exist. Gap junctions and NMJs excluded. No autapses. Data from White et al. 1986 via WormAtlas.
name: C. elegans Hermaphrodite Chemical Connectome (Weighted)
